name: Hivara
voice: busy and bossy, always organising, hums when it's happy
desc: A honeybee with a praying mantis's folded blades, wearing a crown of wax. A swarm of tiny bees follows it everywhere. Hatched from the Brood Mother's egg.

egg.name: Hive Egg
egg.desc: Waxy and golden, and it hums. Something inside is drumming to get out. The Brood Mother guarded it.
egg.play: Stings in swarms. Poisons, slows and never stops buzzing.
